links.outcome: Accuracy and unsafe recall of a hybrid safety layer classifying and blocking unsafe health queries
links.effect: Signed GNN safety classifier reached 88.8% accuracy and 90.6% unsafe recall on 2,537 Turkish queries, outperforming zero-shot LLM baselines including Llama 3.3 70B.
links.quote: a signed graph neural network (GNN) with APPNP-style propagation classifies boundary cases by clinical intent, achieving 88.8% accuracy and 90.6% unsafe recall on a 2,537-query annotated Turkish health dataset while outperforming zero-shot LLM baselines including Llama 3.3 70B.

unlisted_practices: Running the health assistant locally on consumer hardware so no patient data is sent to external services
Rule-based pre-filter for crisis signals and jailbreak attempts combined with a GNN intent classifier
Temporal knowledge graph for persistent cross-session memory

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of a locally deployable agentic health assistant including a dedicated two-stage safety guardrail layer for crisis detection and jailbreak/safety filtering evaluated on a clinical benchmark.

primary.practice: safety guardrail layer (hybrid rule-based and GNN query filtering)
